findings.title: Approved V2 finals are refused by the M10 CONTAINER_STREAM probe
findings.detail: Both V2 finals use pix_fmt yuvj420p (full range); the probe worker accepts only yuv420p and fails the technical probe (M10_PROBE_FAILED, recorded with ResourceEvidence). M10 quality cannot assess real V2 output until the renderer emits yuv420p or the probe admits yuvj420p with a range fact. The pilot continued on a yuv420p-normalized derivative.
findings.status: RESOLVED 0299b0a11: probe admits yuvj420p, route requalified (180 tests); run 2 used the original finals

findings.title: Cross-root determinism criterion conflicts with the manifest's provenance binding
findings.detail: Members (video, thumbnail, metadata) are byte-identical across clean roots; manifest.json differs in selection_id/digest, disposition_id/digest and candidate_payload_digest. Same-root re-export is byte-identical. Either amend the criterion to member-level determinism or move provenance out of the archive.
findings.status: DECIDED 7609bceac: determinism defined by same-selection re-export and content members; provenance stays in the manifest

findings.title: Packaging grant reader assumes root-owned governance
findings.detail: packaging_deps verifies governance with expected_uid=0 while the selection custodian uses os.getuid(); consistent only when the app runs as root (as on V2 staging). A non-root host cannot export without an override.
findings.status: RESOLVED 55edfa11c: custody owner from PackagingDeps (root by default) for both grant reader and selection custodian

findings.title: Stale attestor socket after stopping the served app
findings.detail: After SIGTERM of the pilot host the attestor socket remained and the next attestor refused to start until it was removed. Cause not isolated (wrapper vs graceful shutdown).
findings.status: CLOSED as pilot-harness artifact: uvicorn re-raises SIGTERM after shutdown (uvicorn/server.py capture_signals), so the in-process attestor context never unlinked its socket; production runs the attestor as its own systemd service

findings.title: Fixture policy freshness of 60 s expires runs almost immediately
findings.detail: Pilot profile used 7 days; real profiles need an explicit freshness choice.
